Orr sued and settled with Chicago in 1983 for US$450,000, one-third of what was owed. This contradicts your $600,000 for 1977-78 (and suggests 1976-77 and 1978-79 were not paid at face value either). HZP still lists $500,000 for 1977-78. He played 10 games in 1975-76, 20 in 1976-77 and 6 in 1978-79 (retired Nov 1978).
